rounds.text: Oswal Pumps Ltd is heavily under-appreciated because its valuation multiples sit at a steep discount to sector benchmarks, with a P/E of 10.45x against a sector benchmark of 27.45x and an EV/EBITDA of 7.07x compared to 18.02x [E6, E11]. This cheap pricing contrasts sharply with phenomenal fundamental performance, including a 3-year compounded sales growth of 67% and a 3-year compounded profit growth of 102% [E14, E16]. Furthermore, profitability metrics are exceptional, boasting a ROCE of 26.88% versus a sector benchmark of 18.2% and a median return on equity of 45% over five years [E10, E19]. The company is also conservatively financed with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14x, having actively reduced its borrowings down to Rs 210 Cr [E30, E31]. Conceded: [E26] operating cash flow is negative at Rs -99 Cr in Mar 2026 and cash conversion stands at -0.35x.
